name: mod-monitor
description: Watches how your other mods really behave: hook failures and slow hooks (read off the chain's own trace), what each one did (toasts, status lines, commands, processes, model calls, writes), with /mods for a live pane and /mods report for the last day, week or month. Changes nothing they do; no model calls.

alerts.title: Toast a mod's first failure
alerts.description: Toast the first time each mod's hook fails in a session, and once when a mod's commands fail 5 times in 10 minutes. Later failures are only counted.

slowMs.title: Slow hook after (ms)
slowMs.description: A hook that takes longer than this (its own time, the hooks beneath it not counted) is logged as slow. Drawing a pane or the band counts as slow from 250 ms, or from this value when it is lower.

watchRender.title: Watch panes and the band
watchRender.description: Also watch the mods' Pane and band (AbovePrompt) drawing for failures and slow draws. Draws are never counted, only their failures and slow ones.

watchCommands.title: Watch mod commands
watchCommands.description: Record which mod commands you use and catch failures in them. Off: mod-monitor's name stops appearing beside other mods' command output.

retentionDays.title: Keep logs (days)
retentionDays.description: Day folders under ~/.claude/mods/monitor older than this are deleted when a session starts.

flushSeconds.title: Write the log every (seconds)
flushSeconds.description: How often this session's log file is rewritten from memory; it is also written when the session ends.
